scope: Fresh questions on the same six-document corpus; some are boundary variants of development topics. Not new-corpus or independent external validation.
evaluation_rules: Freeze annotations and local candidate before first run.
Review answers manually against preserved conditions; evidence coverage and citation IDs are not answer accuracy.
If these results drive tuning, move this set to regression use and create a fresh holdout.
Report every failure and retry separately; do not choose only successful runs.

cases.question: 假设我符合 G&D Fund 资格，申请费用恰好为1000美元。按金额档位，需要经理还是经理加VP审批？

金额档位不意味着自动获批
failure_conditions: 把1000美元归入必须经理加VP的档位

cases.question: 今年没用完的 G&D 预算能结转到明年吗？也可以让给同事用吗？

个人预算不能转给同事共享

evidence.quote: No. Unspent G&D budgets do not roll over from one year to the next.

cases.question: 计划休PTO连续25个自然日（已经包含周末和节假日）。仅因这个时长，就触发超过25天的特殊审批吗？是否仍需与经理协调和安排工作覆盖？
required_points: 恰好25天未超过25天，不能仅因时长认定触发该特殊流程
仍需与经理协调并制定工作覆盖计划

evidence.quote: - GitLab does not set a specific limit on the amount of PTO a team member can take per year. However, for time off exceeding 25 consecutive calendar days (including weekends and holidays), special permission is required from your Manager, People Business Partner, and the Absence Management Team at [leaves@gitlab.com](mailto:leaves@gitlab.com).
Our Flexible PTO policy means that as long as you have coordinated with your manager about your planned time off and made a coverage plan, you are free to take PTO.

原文例外为家属有严重健康状况，不得遗漏或泛化

cases.question: 假设我符合带薪育儿假资格，也符合所在地法定育儿假补贴资格，GitLab 的工资和法定补贴相加能超过平时周工资的100%吗？
required_points: 两者合计不会超过周工资100%
符合资格需申请法定补贴，GitLab补足到100%而非另叠加100%
failure_conditions: 称可以领取超过100%的合计金额

evidence.quote: If you live in a country or US state where a statutory benefit is available, you will be *required* to apply for statutory leave pay (if eligible), and GitLab will supplement your pay to equal 100% of your weekly wages. You will not receive more than 100% of your wages with statutory leave and Parental Leave combined.

cases.question: 仅按知识库中的 Caregiver Sick Time 通用申报流程：在加拿大照顾生病家属而连续请假6天，应通过Tilt申请吗？应该联系哪个团队、在Workday选择什么标签？

使用Out Sick或GitLab Parental Leave作为此类标签

evidence.heading_path: Caregiver Sick Time → Reporting Procedures → For Caregiver Sick Absences 6+ Consecutive Days
evidence.quote:
Caregiver sick absences that are 6 days or longer are considered a **leave of absence**.

**USA:** Please submit your Leave request to Tilt (accessed through Okta).

**All other Locations:** Follow the instructions below.

1. Notify the Absence Management Team by submitting a Compass ticket. This allows us to share more about the GitLab Caregiver Sick Time Policy, review statutory benefits you may be eligible for, and walk you through any other next steps.
2. Enter the time away in Workday by selecting the label “Caregiver Sick Time”
   - *Note*: the Absence Management team may need to edit your entries or replace the entry with a Leave Type on your behalf
3. Eligibility for a leave of absence under GitLab’s Caregiver Sick policy will require team members to provide evidence, in accordance with local requirements, supporting the need for Caregiver Leave. Please be aware that the exact documentation required may vary by location (i.e. medical certificate, doctor’s note, fit note, etc.).
   - Team Members should submit the documentation to the Absence Management team (Compass ticket).
